messages:
marta: quick heads-up — planning a dry-run transport for private installer v1.4.6 to VPC customers tonight 22:00 UTC. need quorum on canary escorts before staged pin. deploy-bot will be throttled for safety.
liam: what do you mean by quorum here? which escorts are in-scope?
tasha: quorum = 3 healthy escorts in each region (us-west, eu-west). i'll watch cosign/verifier and signer latencies.
ben: any rollback thresholds we should codify before we start?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run job 5401234567 for installer-v1.4.6 -> staging-escort. throttle=50%, window=30m. notifying watchers.
marta: rollback criteria proposal: abort and repin previous manifest if >3% delivery failures OR any cosign verification error OR sustained deploy-bot latency >600s. also manual abort if any customer-impacting error seen.
liam: +1. if network egress causes retries we should auto-decrease concurrency — avoids retry storms.
tasha: i'll run prechecks now: cosign verify + sha256 on mirrors. sample command: ```
$ cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/installer-sign
Verification OK: installer-v1.4.6.tar.gz
$ sha256sum installer-v1.4.6.tar.gz
3b2f...  installer-v1.4.6.tar.gz
```
ben: note: staged pin should be 'staged-pin-epoch-2026-04-12' not full rollout. we'll hold full rollout until post-window signoff. i'll draft release note blurb.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: dry-run start -> canary set [escort-usw-3, escort-euw-1, escort-euw-2, escort-usw-1, escort-usw-2]. progress updates every 5m.
marta: if any cosign mismatch, immediate rollback. tasha, please surface any KMS latency >2s (that's our hot-path cutoff).
tasha: seeing two transient timeouts from escort-usw-2 (120s, 180s) — retry succeeded. cosign checks all OK so far.
liam: recommend prefetching signatures into offline signer cache to avoid KMS spike on pin. ops can we do that?
ben: ops ok — will prefetch and prime cache. also monitoring egress quotas; if deploy-bot reports >600s handshake, reduce throttle to 10% and pause new canaries.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: dry-run progress update: canary results 3/5 OK, 2/5 transient timeouts (retries succeeded). no cosign verification errors. artifacts pinned to epoch-2026-04-12-dryrun.
marta: good. plan: proceed to staged pin at 23:30 UTC if no additional regressions. @tasha please sign off in channel at 23:15 if clear.
tasha: will do. i'll tail transport.log and post any anomalies.
ben: release note (prelim): "Private installer v1.4.6 — dry-run passed; staged pin scheduled 23:30 UTC. No cosign key rotation applied. Watch window active until 00:30 UTC."
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: will enforce throttle=25% for staged-pin job and post completion + metrics to this thread.
marta: :thumbsup: thanks all — i'll ping on-call if anything escalates.
